chains.title: HOXB13 binds the rs339331 ref-T allele more strongly and activates RFX6 in prostate cells

links.claim: HOXB13 binds the rs339331 ref T allele more strongly than the alt C allele at the 6q22 locus.
rs339331 lies in a prostate-cell enhancer/regulatory element whose output is altered by allele-specific HOXB13 occupancy.
The rs339331 enhancer regulates RFX6, the nearby 6q22 target gene.
This occurs in LNCaP clone FGC (DepMap ACH-000977), a prostate cancer cell line with HOXB13 activity.
Higher HOXB13 occupancy on the ref T allele increases RFX6 expression and contributes to prostate cancer risk at 6q22.

predictions: HOXB13 ChIP at rs339331 is higher on the ref T allele than the alt C allele.
An rs339331 ref-T enhancer reporter is more active than the alt-C reporter in LNCaP cells and this difference is HOXB13-dependent.
RFX6 expression is higher in prostate cells carrying the ref T allele or after HOXB13 overexpression.
The ref T allele is associated with higher prostate cancer risk at 6q22.
falsified_if: No reproducible allele-specific HOXB13 binding at rs339331 is found.
The ref-T reporter is not more active than the alt-C reporter in LNCaP cells.
RFX6 expression is not affected by HOXB13 or by the rs339331 allele.

chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect of rs339331; the association reflects a linked causal variant or passenger signal
predictions: No reproducible allele-specific TF binding at rs339331 is found.
The rs339331 ref and alt enhancer reporters show no allele-specific activity difference in LNCaP cells.
RFX6 expression is not allele-specifically affected by rs339331.
The prostate cancer association at 6q22 is explained by a linked causal variant or by a passenger signal.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific TF binding and enhancer/RFX6 effect at rs339331 is demonstrated in prostate cells.

predictions: HOXB13 ChIP at rs339331 is higher on the ref T allele than the alt C allele.

next_experiment: Allele-specific enhancer reporter assay in LNCaP clone FGC (DepMap ACH-000977): clone the rs339331 ref-T and alt-C enhancer upstream of a minimal promoter/luciferase, transfect into LNCaP cells with and without HOXB13 knockdown, and measure luciferase. A ref-T > alt-C, HOXB13-dependent reporter difference supports C1; a ref-T < alt-C difference supports C2; no allele-specific or HOXB13-dependent difference supports the null C4.
